<description>
`IsWellFormedPackage` sums the package weight with `std::accumulate` starting from a plain `0`, so the running total is an `int`. A package heavier than `INT_MAX` would wrap and could pass the `MAX_PACKAGE_WEIGHT` check. No package that large reaches this check today, since RPC request bodies are capped at 32 MiB and P2P messages at 4 MB, so this is defense in depth. It picks up the one-line fix from #35473, which was closed with an invitation to do so.

I start the sum from `int64_t{0}`, as the vsize sum in `validation.cpp` already does. I did not add a test, since the one on #35473 was turned down. I checked the fix locally with a throwaway test that puts one transaction of 88M weight into a package 25 times: before the fix the package is rejected as `package-contains-duplicates`, after it as `package-too-large`.
</description>
